notes: Declares the test class RetryPolicyTests abstract. JUnit Jupiter does not run the tests of an abstract class (TestClassPredicates at r5.14.4 requires a standalone test class to be not abstract), and nothing in the patch extends it, so every test in the class silently stops running. Rejected with disable/test_removed under the ruling that a test class made abstract removes its tests. Adapted: no merged change was found that makes a test class abstract on its own. The modifier is hand written on the pre image of RetryPolicyTests.java at the merge base of Azure/azure-sdk-for-java PR 26548, the pre image of accept-tzd-format-in-utc; every context and removed line is the pre image's own. RetryPolicy here is the project's own class under test, not a retry library. Not from IDoFT: neither the repository nor the test class appears in pr-data.csv under any status.
